caption: Japanese Tea Garden @ SF
alt: A red pagoda framed by trees at the Japanese Tea Garden
excerpt: The most fascinating aspect of photography is that you never know the circumstances of the person behind the lens. On the particular day I took this photo, it was a very busy weekend and there was a huge crowd of people all gathered together with the goal of touring around the area. I mean it made sense, the Japanese Tea Garden is one of the most popular sights in SF. I had an added goal to leave with a captured moment. The only problem was that because there were so many people, I had to go fight against crowds and stand my ground. It's funny though, because you never would've thought it was busy and chaotic based on the serenity of the photo.
